body: Create a macro photograph of a tiny {{animal}} made entirely from one ripe {{fruit}}. Its silhouette, ears and paws are formed naturally from the fruit flesh, while the skin texture, seeds and leaves remain convincingly edible. The creature sits on a plain ceramic plate beside one normal fruit for scale. Gentle window light, shallow depth of field, playful but physically coherent construction, no eyes pasted on, clean square composition.

instructions.en: No reference image is needed. Copy the full prompt into your image generator.
instructions.zh-Hans: 无需参考图，将完整提示词复制到图像生成工具即可。

en.title: Fruit animal miniature
en.description: A strawberry becomes a tiny kitten, with seeds and fruit flesh forming its face and paws.
en.body:
## How to use

Keep the animal small and the fruit material continuous. Change animal and fruit together; preserve the ordinary fruit beside it as a scale reference.

## Recorded result

The default was generated with the built-in image tool. The precise provider model ID was not returned. Other values are not yet tested.

zh-Hans.title: 水果变小动物
zh-Hans.description: 草莓的果肉与籽粒构成小猫的脸、耳朵和爪子。
zh-Hans.body:
## 使用方法

保持小动物尺寸与水果材质连贯，可同时替换动物和水果，保留旁边的普通水果作为尺度参照。

## 实测结果

默认样例由内置图像工具生成，工具未返回精确的模型 ID。其他参数组合尚未实测。
